notes: Registered for ADR 0031 item 5: the family contrast at a held 7B size, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 vs this model. No v1 folder exists for it, so nothing here is a port; every field mirrors an existing folder rather than being chosen. prompt.md is byte-identical to qwen3_5_9b/prompt.md (same Qwen chat-template shape, <<<USER>>> split marker) and prompt_unguided.md was generated by run_decomposer.derive_unguided_template, so the parity guard in tests/test_decomposer_conditions.py holds by construction. enable_thinking=false mirrors qwen3_5_9b; Qwen2.5-Instruct's chat template ignores the kwarg (verified: apply_chat_template renders the same string with and without it). strip_think=false because Qwen2.5-Instruct is not a reasoning model and emits no <think> block - qwen3_5_9b sets true because Qwen3.5 does; on a stream with no <think> the two settings are identical. trust_remote_code=false: model_type is qwen2, registered in the pinned transformers - same as components/router/models/qwen2_5_7b and the qwen2_5_3b decomposer. quantization none mirrors mistral_7b_instruct, the arm this one is contrasted against, so the 7B family contrast does not also move precision; ~7.62B params in float16 is ~15.2 GB, which fits the 24 GiB 3090 only when the card is free - pass --quantization 4bit if it is contended, and the runner records the resolved value. max_new_tokens 256 is the per-model plumbing default (qwen3_5_9b's value); configs/decomposer_musique.json overrides it to 1024 identically for every condition. Weights are already in the local HF cache (15 GB, snapshot a09a35458c70), verified resolving with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. Parameter count 7,615,616,512 - under decomposer_max_params and under the standing 8e9 too. Re-derive it with scripts/print_model_params.py --model qwen2_5_7b_instruct --offline (ADR 0027); that script reads safetensors metadata only and loads no weights.
